# Code Anchors: Planning Run Folder

- `libs/epic-resolve/src/planning-dir.ts` — computes the run folder's path per entry mode (epic slug, feature slug ahead of the right-size gate, or discovery folder slug) and performs its guarded removal (#638)
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/planning-dir.spec.ts` — pins the naming rule per mode and the removal guard (#638)
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — creates the run folder before the right-size gate, writes the draft, the materialized source text and any decomposition stubs inside it, names its path at the approval gate, and deletes it only after a complete filing (#638)
- `components/commands/nxs.setup.md` — appends the `.nexus/tmp/` ignore entry idempotently, so a planning run never checks or writes it (#638)
